info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Order Allocation Management API
info.description: The Order Allocation Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and adjust order allocations within their banking operations. This endpoint allows users to modify existing order allocation details based on specific parameters, ensuring optimal resource distribution and reduced operational overhead. Ideal for banking institutions and financial service providers, this API supports dynamic updates to allocation strategies and facilitates more effective market operations. Utilize this API to drive greater agility and responsiveness in order fulfillment processes, enhancing overall customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

patch.summary: Update the allocation details for a specific order.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the allocation information for a specific order identified by its resource ID. Use this operation to change the allocation settings or correct any discrepancies in the order details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the order allocation details for a specific reservation identified by RES-100045. The provided JSON payload should contain the necessary fields to modify the existing order allocation information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the order allocation has been updated.
